landing.tagline: A personal system for running a job search.
landing.faqWhatAnswer: Captures a job posting in one click from LinkedIn or an ATS page, keeps a running log of every message and interview round against it, tailors a résumé from a bank of bullets, and puts the full interview brief in front of me before any call — plus a Telegram nudge whenever a thread's gone quiet or a follow-up is due.
landing.faqSpreadsheetAnswer: I tried. It survives about a week before a cell goes stale, and it has no memory of a LinkedIn thread or an email that happened outside of it.
landing.faqNotDoAnswer: Apply on my behalf, scrape LinkedIn from a server, or know about a posting I didn't capture myself.
landing.faqWhoForAnswer: Right now, one person: me, running one job search.
landing.footerTagline: Built as a personal tool for one job search.
